decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the requirement that the battery connector permit cable insertion when USB-C passes through the case opening.
The source identifies the L-shaped battery connector as the accessibility problem and does not constrain the panel power-button connector.
Battery-cable access around USB-C does not change the ESP32 module or through-hole breakout requirements.
The source concerns physical battery-connector accessibility, not the electrical battery or USB power-path topology.
The client explicitly identifies the enclosure obstructing battery-cable insertion, necessarily adding an enclosure-access constraint.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Thanks for sharing, everything looks good, I can see only one potential issue. The connector above usb, probably battery since is is L shape and usb must go through case opening then we will not be able to plug the battery cable in it as case will get in the way.

value_updates.battery_connector_accessibility: The enclosure must not obstruct battery-cable insertion when USB-C passes through the case opening.
